resolved_findings.finding: A possibly negative-infinite endpoint ranking extension cannot enter an everywhere product inequality because zero times negative infinity is undefined.
resolved_findings.resolution: Virtual identity, pointwise product bound and attainment now apply on finite interior profiles, hence almost surely. Endpoint extensions are only for allocation ranking; endpoint payments use the allocation integral. No case/solution/number changed.

resolved_findings.finding: Strictly increasing virtual values can jump across zero, so a zero need not exist.
resolved_findings.resolution: Reserve is now the infimum nonnegative-virtual threshold with the rule’s explicit boundary eligibility; the critical payment is the threshold. A zero is identified only when it exists. The cases use continuous linear virtual values, so no numerical changes.
